# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `tiktok-for-business` MCP server pointing at TikTok's hosted Progressive Disclosure endpoint (`https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_mcp/tt-ads-mcp-layer`), which loads about 40 core tools up front and the rest on demand.
- Auth uses OAuth with TikTok for Business sign-in — no API key, developer app, or client ID to configure.
- Logo: TikTok's official app icon.
